isolation.sessionRule: Used named agent-browser sessions only; no default session used.

assertions.title: Home-to-library-to-case-study discovery works end to end

steps.action: Open / and inspect the global shell and project cards
steps.expected: Home renders with global navigation and trust-rich project entry points
steps.observed: Home rendered with Home/Projects/Resume links and six trust-framed project cards.

steps.action: Use the Home navigation link to go to /projects
steps.expected: Projects library loads cleanly and remains usable for discovery
steps.observed: Navigation reached /projects, but the page hit a client-side chunk failure (`Loading chunk 7177 failed`) and the browser snapshot returned no interactive elements until the route was hard-opened again.

steps.action: Enter a case-study detail page from the projects library
steps.expected: A detail page opens with preserved trust context and working shell navigation
steps.observed: After reopening /projects directly, the Tesla NACS card opened /projects/tesla-nacs and showed the shared shell plus route trust content.

evidence.consoleErrors: On Home -> Projects navigation, `Loading chunk 7177 failed` and repeated `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 500 (Internal Server Error)` errors occurred on /projects.
evidence.network: GET / -> 200; GET /projects -> 200; GET /projects/tesla-nacs -> 200. Browser console still logged failing chunk/resource requests on /projects.

assertions.issues: The end-to-end discovery flow is not reliably usable because navigating into /projects from the shell can strand the user on a broken client state before they can continue browsing.

assertions.title: Keyboard-first navigation remains viable across shell and drawers

steps.action: On /, tab into the global shell
steps.expected: Keyboard focus moves through shell controls with visible focus indication
steps.observed: The first Tab reached the skip link and header controls; the screenshot captured the keyboard-reachable shell on home.

steps.action: On /projects, tab through the shell and filter controls
steps.expected: Project filters and links remain keyboard-reachable with visible focus
steps.observed: The /projects route repeatedly entered the same client chunk failure state, and after tabbing the active element collapsed to BODY with no usable interactive snapshot.

steps.action: On a case-study route, tab into trust/drawer-related controls
steps.expected: Trust/drawer entry points can be reached and activated from the keyboard with visible focus
steps.observed: On /projects/tesla-nacs, after repeated Tab presses the active element again resolved to BODY while the page logged chunk/resource errors, so viable keyboard focus on deeper controls could not be proven.

evidence.consoleErrors: `Loading chunk 7177 failed` plus multiple 500/404 resource errors occurred during keyboard testing on /projects and /projects/tesla-nacs.
evidence.network: GET /projects -> 200 and GET /projects/tesla-nacs -> 200, but required client chunks/resources failed in-browser, leaving BODY focused instead of usable controls.

assertions.issues: Keyboard-first traversal is not reliable across major surfaces because the projects shell and case-study flow can lose interactive focusability due to client chunk failures.

assertions.title: Every portfolio card reaches a unique, non-broken destination

steps.expected: All home cards point to unique case-study routes
steps.observed: The six Home cards linked to `/projects/ord-lga-price-war`, `/projects/fraud-radar`, `/projects/target-shrink`, `/projects/starbucks-pivot`, `/projects/tesla-nacs`, and `/projects/netflix-roi`.

steps.expected: All index cards point to the same set of unique case-study routes without duplicates
steps.observed: The Projects index exposed the same six unique case-study routes.

steps.action: Verify route reachability and open one representative index card
steps.expected: Each destination returns successfully and opened cards land on route-specific detail pages
steps.observed: Curl returned HTTP 200 for all six case-study routes, and clicking the Tesla NACS card from /projects opened `http://localhost:3501/projects/tesla-nacs` with route-specific content.

evidence.consoleErrors: Opening the representative Tesla NACS route logged some 500/404 resource errors, but the route still rendered route-specific content and the underlying destinations were unique and reachable.
evidence.network: GET /projects/ord-lga-price-war -> 200; GET /projects/fraud-radar -> 200; GET /projects/target-shrink -> 200; GET /projects/starbucks-pivot -> 200; GET /projects/tesla-nacs -> 200; GET /projects/netflix-roi -> 200.

assertions.title: Users can navigate from resume and case studies back into portfolio browsing

steps.expected: Resume page exposes working navigation back to Home or Projects
steps.observed: Resume rendered with shared Home/Projects/Resume navigation and footer links.

steps.expected: User returns to portfolio browsing and can continue exploring
steps.observed: The browser reached /projects, but the same `Loading chunk 7177 failed` client error appeared with repeated 500 resource errors, preventing a clean continuation of browsing.

steps.action: Activate Projects from a case-study route
steps.expected: Case-study navigation returns to a usable browsing surface
steps.observed: From /projects/tesla-nacs, the Projects link again reached /projects but logged 404/500 resource failures and did not demonstrate a clean, reliable browsing surface.

evidence.consoleErrors: Both resume->projects and detail->projects navigation produced `Loading chunk 7177 failed` and repeated 500/404 resource errors on /projects.
evidence.network: GET /resume -> 200; GET /projects/tesla-nacs -> 200; subsequent navigation target /projects returned 200 HTML but failed required browser resources/chunks.

assertions.issues: Return-to-browsing navigation exists in the shell, but it currently leads users into a broken /projects client state instead of a dependable browsing surface.

frictions.description: The /projects route intermittently loaded into a broken client state after in-app navigation, showing `Loading chunk 7177 failed` and leaving agent-browser snapshots with no interactive elements until the route was reopened directly.
frictions.resolution: Worked around it for evidence gathering by hard-opening /projects in a fresh/named browser session, but the product issue remains and caused assertion failures where reliable in-app navigation was required.

frictions.description: Raw page text on App Router pages included streamed script/payload content, so text capture was noisy for keyboard-state inspection.
frictions.resolution: Used screenshots, URL checks, focused-element inspection, and console/error logs instead of relying on body text alone.

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 1 passed and 3 failed. The main regression is that navigating into /projects from resume, case-study, or home shell routes can trigger a client-side chunk/resource failure, which also prevents reliable keyboard-first validation across the shared navigation shell.
